name: Aura: Angelic Halo
descr:
Granted by [Angelic Halo](/spell/angelic-halo-player-core-2)

Allies in your halo's emanation who are healed by a *[heal](/spell/heal-player-core)* spell gain a status bonus to Hit Points regained equal to double the *heal* spell's rank.

name: Cursebound
descr: Your oracular curse is constricting around you as you receive divine punishment after drawing too deeply on your mystery's powers. Cursebound is a condition that affects only creatures with an oracular curse, and cursebound always includes a value. Your specific oracular curse imposes unique negative effects depending on your cursebound value. You can remove the cursebound condition only by Refocusing.

name: Effect: Aberrant Blood Magic
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Aberrant](/feat/bloodline-aberrant-player-core-2)

Either one target takes a –1 status penalty to Will saving throws for 1 round or you gain a +2 status bonus to Will saving throws for 1 round.

name: Effect: Alchemist Goggles
descr:
Granted by [Alchemist Goggles](/item/alchemist-goggles-player-core-2)

When making Strikes with alchemical bombs, you ignore lesser cover.

name: Effect: Angelic Blood Magic
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Angelic](/feat/bloodline-angelic-player-core-2)

An angelic aura protects you or one target, granting a +1 status bonus to saving throws for 1 round.

name: Effect: Animalistic Brutality
descr:
Granted by [Animalistic Brutality](/feat/animalistic-brutality-player-core-2)

Your unarmed attack from bestial rage gains one of the following traits until you stop raging: backswing, forceful, parry, razing, or sweep.

name: Effect: Anoint Ally
descr: Granted by [Anoint Ally](/feat/anoint-ally-player-core-2).

name: Effect: Aura of Despair
descr:
Granted by [Aura Of Despair](/feat/aura-of-despair-player-core-2)

Enemies within 15 of you take a -1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against fear.

name: Effect: Aura of Determination
descr:
Granted by [Aura Of Determination](/feat/aura-of-determination-player-core-2)

You and all allies in your champion's aura gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental, morph, and polymorph effects.

name: Effect: Aura of Faith
descr:
Granted by [Aura Of Faith](/feat/aura-of-faith-player-core-2)

You add the [holy](/trait/holy) trait to your Strikes.

name: Effect: Aura of Life
descr:
Granted by [Aura Of Life](/feat/aura-of-life-player-core-2)

You gain resistance 5 to void damage and a +1 status bonus to saves against void effects.

name: Effect: Aura of Righteousness
descr:
Granted by [Aura Of Righteousness](/feat/aura-of-righteousness-player-core-2)

You gain resistance 5 to unholy effects.

name: Effect: Balisse Feather
descr:
Granted by [Balisse Feather](/item/balisse-feather-player-core-2), [Balisse Feather (Greater)](/item/balisse-feather-greater-player-core-2)

Unless you have the [holy](/trait/holy) trait, you take a –2 status penalty to AC and saving throws.

name: Effect: Battle Planner
descr:
Granted by [Battle Planner](/feat/battle-planner-player-core-2)

Roll a Warfare Lore check. As long as the information was accurate and remains accurate when you roll initiative against those enemies, you can use the Warfare Lore result you previously rolled for your initiative roll.

name: Effect: Benefactor's Majesty
descr:
Granted by [Benefactor'S Majesty](/feat/benefactor-s-majesty-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

name: Effect: Bestial Mutagen (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Bestial Mutagen (Greater)](/item/bestial-mutagen-greater-player-core-2)

You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack (3d8 slashing damage) with the [agile](/trait/agile) trait and a jaws unarmed attack (3d10 piercing damage).

You take a –2 penalty to Reflex saves, Acrobatics checks, and Stealth checks.

name: Effect: Bestial Mutagen (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Bestial Mutagen (Lesser)](/item/bestial-mutagen-lesser-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack (1d4 slashing damage) with the [agile](/trait/agile) trait and a jaws unarmed attack (1d6 piercing damage).

You take a –2 penalty to Reflex saves, Acrobatics checks, and Stealth checks.

name: Effect: Bestial Mutagen (Major)
descr:
Granted by [Bestial Mutagen (Major)](/item/bestial-mutagen-major-player-core-2)

You gain a +4 item bonus to Athletics checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack (4d8 slashing damage) with the [agile](/trait/agile) trait and a jaws unarmed attack (4d10 piercing damage). You gain weapon specialization with the claw and jaws, or greater weapon specialization if you already have weapon specialization with these unarmed attacks.

You take a –2 penalty to Reflex saves, Acrobatics checks, and Stealth checks.

name: Effect: Bestial Mutagen (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Bestial Mutagen (Moderate)](/item/bestial-mutagen-moderate-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack (2d6 slashing damage) with the [agile](/trait/agile) trait and a jaws unarmed attack (2d8 piercing damage).

You take a –2 penalty to Reflex saves, Acrobatics checks, and Stealth checks.

name: Effect: Blessed Armament
descr:
The item gains the effect of a property rune.

---

From *[Blessed Armament](/feat/blessed-armament-player-core-2)*

[Vitalizing](/item/vitalizing-gm-core), [Ghost Touch](/item/ghost-touch-gm-core), [Fearsome](/item/fearsome-gm-core), [Returning](/item/returning-gm-core), or [Shifting](/item/shifting-gm-core)

---

From *[Radiant Armament](/feat/radiant-armament-player-core-2)*:

[Astral](/item/astral-gm-core), [Brilliant](/item/brilliant-gm-core), [Holy](/item/holy-gm-core), or [Unholy](/item/unholy-gm-core)

---

From *[Armament Paragon](/feat/armament-paragon-player-core-2)*:

[Animated](/item/animated-gm-core), [Vitalizing (Greater)](/item/vitalizing-greater-gm-core), or [Keen](/item/keen-gm-core)

name: Effect: Blessed Counterstrike
descr:
Granted by [Blessed Counterstrike](/feat/blessed-counterstrike-player-core-2)

The target gains weakness equal to half your level to all Strikes made by you and your allies.

name: Effect: Blessed Swiftness
descr:
Granted by [Blessed Swiftness](/feat/blessed-swiftness-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 status bonus to all defenses against reactions triggered by your movement.

name: Effect: Blood Sovereignty
descr:
Granted by [Blood Sovereignty](/feat/blood-sovereignty-player-core-2)

You lose Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

name: Effect: Bon Mot
descr:
Granted by [Bon Mot](/feat/bon-mot-player-core-2)

You take a status penalty to Perception and Will saves.

name: Effect: Can't Fall Here
descr:
Granted by [Can'T Fall Here](/feat/can-t-fall-here-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the origin's level.

name: Effect: Cantorian Rejuvenation
descr:
Granted by [Cantorian Rejuvenation](/feat/cantorian-rejuvenation-player-core-2)

You gain 10 temporary Hit Points. At 15th level, you instead gain 15 temporary HP.

name: Effect: Cat Nap
descr:
Granted by [Cat Nap](/feat/cat-nap-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

name: Effect: Catfolk Dance
descr:
Granted by [Catfolk Dance](/feat/catfolk-dance-player-core-2)

You gain a −2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves. On a critical success, you are also off-guard.

name: Effect: Cavalier's Banner
descr:
Granted by [Cavalier'S Banner](/feat/cavalier-s-banner-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves and DCs against fear effects. If your banner is destroyed or removed, allies within 30 feet become [Frightened 1](/condition/frightened-player-core).

name: Effect: Champion's Extra Damage
descr:
Granted by [Destructive Vengeance](/action/destructive-vengeance-player-core-2), [Iron Command](/action/iron-command-player-core-2), [Selfish Shield](/action/selfish-shield-player-core-2)

Your strikes against the triggering creature deal extra spirit damage.

name: Effect: Champion's Resistance
descr: The ally gains resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to 2 + your level.

name: Effect: Clue In
descr:
Granted by [Clue In](/action/clue-in-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check. If the origin has investigator expertise, this bonus increases to +2.

name: Effect: Cognitive Mutagen (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Cognitive Mutagen (Greater)](/item/cognitive-mutagen-greater-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +3 item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to Recall Knowledge. Your critical failures on Recall Knowledge checks become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, Athletics checks, and Acrobatics checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered, and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

name: Effect: Cognitive Mutagen (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Cognitive Mutagen (Lesser)](/item/cognitive-mutagen-lesser-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +1 item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to Recall Knowledge. Your critical failures on Recall Knowledge checks become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, Athletics checks, and Acrobatics checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered, and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

name: Effect: Cognitive Mutagen (Major)
descr:
Granted by [Cognitive Mutagen (Major)](/item/cognitive-mutagen-major-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +4 item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to Recall Knowledge. Your critical failures on Recall Knowledge checks become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, Athletics checks, and Acrobatics checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered, and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

descr:
Granted by [Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate)](/item/cognitive-mutagen-moderate-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to Recall Knowledge. Your critical failures on Recall Knowledge checks become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, Athletics checks, and Acrobatics checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered, and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

name: Effect: Come and Get Me
descr:
Granted by [Come And Get Me](/feat/come-and-get-me-player-core-2)

You are [Off Guard](/condition/off-guard-player-core), and damage rolls against you gain a +2 circumstance bonus.

name: Effect: Come and Get Me (Circumstance Bonus)
descr:
Granted by [Come And Get Me](/feat/come-and-get-me-player-core-2)

Ephemeral effect. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls.

name: Effect: Come and Get Me (Temporary Hit Points)
descr:
Granted by [Come And Get Me](/feat/come-and-get-me-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier, or double that on a critical hit. These temporary Hit Points last until the end of your rage.

name: Effect: Command Attention
descr:
Granted by [Command Attention](/feat/command-attention-player-core-2)

When you attempt saving throws against visual effects, you use the outcome for one degree of success better than the result you rolled.

name: Effect: Command Bravery
descr:
Granted by [Warleader'S Bulwark](/item/warleader-s-bulwark-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 status bonus to saves against fear effects.

name: Effect: Connect the Dots
descr:
Granted by [Connect The Dots](/feat/connect-the-dots-player-core-2)

Your ally gains your [Pursue A Lead](/action/pursue-a-lead-player-core-2) investigation bonus as a circumstance bonus to its Strikes or skill checks.

name: Effect: Cringe
descr:
Granted by [Cringe](/feat/cringe-player-core-2) via Ephemeral Effect

You take a circumstance penalty to the Strike's damage equal to 2 + the origin's level.

name: Effect: Crystal Shards
descr:
Granted by [Crystal Shards (Moderate)](/item/crystal-shards-moderate-player-core-2), [Crystal Shards (Greater)](/item/crystal-shards-greater-player-core-2), [Crystal Shards (Major)](/item/crystal-shards-major-player-core-2)

As long as the bleed damage persists, you also take a –5-foot penalty to your speeds.

name: Effect: Deadweight Snare (Failure/Critical Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Deadweight Snare](/item/deadweight-snare-player-core-2)

You take a -2 status penalty to attack rolls.

name: Effect: Deadweight Snare (Success)
descr:
Granted by [Deadweight Snare](/item/deadweight-snare-player-core-2)

You take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls.

name: Effect: Debilitating Bomb
descr:
Granted by [Debilitating Bomb](/feat/debilitating-bomb-player-core-2)

You are dazzled, deafened, off-guard, or take a –5-foot status penalty to Speeds.

If the origin has Greater Debilitating Bomb, add clumsy 1, enfeebled 1 and stupefied 1 to the list, and the status penalty to Speeds increases to –10.

If the origin has True Debilitating Bomb, the value of the enfeebled and [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core) conditions increase to 2, and the status penalty to Speeds increases to –15.

name: Effect: Demonic Blood Magic
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Demonic](/feat/bloodline-demonic-player-core-2)

Either a target takes a -1 status penalty to AC for 1 round, or you gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks.

name: Effect: Desperate Wrath
descr:
Granted by [Desperate Wrath](/feat/desperate-wrath-player-core-2)

You get a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, a –1 penalty to AC, and a –1 penalty to saves. These bonuses and penalties last until your Rage ends or until you are above half Hit Points, whichever comes first.

name: Effect: Devise a Stratagem
descr:
Granted by [Devise A Stratagem](/action/devise-a-stratagem-player-core-2)

Choose a creature you can see. Roll a d20, then decide on an attack stratagem or skill stratagem.

**Attack Stratagem** If you Strike the chosen creature before the start of your next turn, your Strike gains the [fortune](/trait/fortune) trait and you must use the result of the d20 roll for your next Strike's attack roll this round instead of rolling. When you make this substitution, you can add your Intelligence modifier to your attack roll instead of your Strength or Dexterity modifier.

**Skill Stratagem** You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next Intelligence-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based skill check or Perception check involving the target before the start of your next turn. If you would gain your Pursue a Lead investigation bonus to such a check, that bonus increases by 1 instead of you gaining the +1 bonus listed

name: Effect: Diabolic Blood Magic (Self)
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Diabolic](/feat/bloodline-diabolic-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 status bonus to Deception checks for 1 round.

name: Effect: Didactic Strike
descr:
Granted by [Didactic Strike](/feat/didactic-strike-player-core-2).

Your first attack against the designated target before the investigator's next turn deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to the target if it hits.

name: Effect: Diverting Vortex
descr:
Granted by [Diverting Vortex](/feat/diverting-vortex-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC against ranged weapon attacks and physical ranged unarmed attacks.

name: Effect: Divine Aegis
descr:
Granted by [Divine Aegis](/feat/divine-aegis-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against non-divine magical effects, but you also take a -1 circumstance penalty to saves against divine effects.

name: Effect: Divine Health
descr:
Granted by [Divine Health](/feat/divine-health-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against diseases and poisons.

name: Effect: Dragon's Rage Wings
descr:
Granted by [Dragon'S Rage Wings](/feat/dragon-s-rage-wings-player-core-2)

While you are raging, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Effect: Drakeheart Mutagen (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Drakeheart Mutagen (Greater)](/item/drakeheart-mutagen-greater-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain +6 item bonus to AC, a Dexterity cap of +2, and a +3 item bonus to Perception checks.

**Drawback** You take a -1 penalty to Will saves, Reflex saves, and all skill checks to Recall Knowledge.

name: Effect: Drakeheart Mutagen (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Drakeheart Mutagen (Lesser)](/item/drakeheart-mutagen-lesser-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain +4 item bonus to AC, a Dexterity cap of +2, and a +1 item bonus to Perception checks.

**Drawback** You take a -1 penalty to Will saves, Reflex saves, and all skill checks to Recall Knowledge.

name: Effect: Drakeheart Mutagen (Major)
descr:
Granted by [Drakeheart Mutagen (Major)](/item/drakeheart-mutagen-major-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain +7 item bonus to AC, a Dexterity cap of +2, and a +4 item bonus to Perception checks.

**Drawback** You take a -1 penalty to Will saves, Reflex saves, and all skill checks to Recall Knowledge.

name: Effect: Drakeheart Mutagen (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Drakeheart Mutagen (Moderate)](/item/drakeheart-mutagen-moderate-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain +5 item bonus to AC, a Dexterity cap of +2, and a +2 item bonus to Perception checks.

**Drawback** You take a -1 penalty to Will saves, Reflex saves, and all skill checks to Recall Knowledge.

name: Effect: Dread Marshal Stance
descr:
Granted by [Dread Marshal Stance](/feat/dread-marshal-stance-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls. When the marshal or an ally in the aura critically hit an enemy with a Strike, that enemy is [Frightened 1](/condition/frightened-player-core). If the marshal is wielding a weapon that has more than one damage die (typically due to a [striking](/item/striking-gm-core) rune), you can have the status bonus equal the weapon's number of damage dice instead of +1.

name: Effect: Duelist's Challenge
descr:
Granted by [Duelist'S Challenge](/feat/duelist-s-challenge-player-core-2)

Any time you hit your dueling opponent using a single one-handed melee weapon while your other hand or hands are free, you gain a circumstance bonus to the Strike's damage equal to the number of damage dice your weapon deals.

If you attack a creature other than your dueling opponent, you take a circumstance penalty to damage equal to the number of damage dice your weapon deals.

name: Effect: Elemental Blood Magic (Self)
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Elemental](/feat/bloodline-elemental-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks.

name: Effect: Endemic Herbs
descr:
Granted by [Endemic Herbs](/feat/endemic-herbs-player-core-2)

You gain a benefit matching the location where the item was created.

**Aquatic** You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves.**Forest** You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against disease and poison effects.**Mountain** You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves.**Plains** You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.**Underground** You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception.

name: Effect: Energy Ward
descr:
Granted by [Energy Ward](/feat/energy-ward-player-core-2)

You gain resistance to one type of energy (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void) equal to 4 + the rank of the spell.

name: Effect: Enjoy the Show
descr:
Granted by [Enjoy The Show](/feat/enjoy-the-show-player-core-2)

You take a circumstance penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you, or a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls targeting you.

name: Effect: Envenom Fangs
descr:
Granted by [Envenom Fangs](/feat/envenom-fangs-player-core-2)

The next fangs Strike deals an additional 1d6 persistent poison damage.

name: Effect: Even the Odds
descr:
Granted by [Even The Odds](/feat/even-the-odds-player-core-2)

You gain panache.

name: Effect: Exalted Reaction (Desecrator)
descr:
Granted by [Desecration](/feat/desecration-player-core-2)

Each enemy in your champion's aura takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against you.

name: Effect: Exalted Reaction (Redemption)
descr:
Granted by [Exalted Reaction](/feat/exalted-reaction-player-core-2)

You grant the resistance to yourself and all allies in your champion's aura, including the triggering ally. If you do, the resistance is reduced by 2 for all.

name: Effect: Exemplary Finisher (Rascal)
descr:
Granted by [Exemplary Finisher](/feat/exemplary-finisher-player-core-2)

The foe takes a -10 circumstance penalty to its speed until the start of your next turn.

name: Effect: Exemplary Finisher (Wit)
descr:
Granted by [Exemplary Finisher](/feat/exemplary-finisher-player-core-2)

The foe takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against you until the start of your next turn.

name: Effect: Extra Alchemy
descr:
Granted by [Extra Alchemy](/action/extra-alchemy-player-core-2)

You can create one additional item with advanced alchemy.

name: Effect: Extravagant Parry
descr:
Granted by [Extravagant Parry](/feat/extravagant-parry-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, or a +2 circumstance bonus if you have a free hand or are wielding a weapon with the [parry](/trait/parry) trait.

name: Effect: Fey Blood Magic
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Fey](/feat/bloodline-fey-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 status bonus to Performance checks.

name: Effect: Field Discovery (Chirurgeon)
descr:
Granted by [Chirurgeon](/feat/chirurgeon-player-core-2)

The creature gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your Intelligence modifier.

name: Effect: Flensing Slice
descr:
Granted by [Flensing Slice](/feat/flensing-slice-player-core-2)

You are off-guard and take 1d8 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die of whichever weapon the origin used has the most weapon damage dice.

name: Effect: Frost Vial
descr:
Granted by [Frost Vial (Lesser)](/item/frost-vial-lesser-player-core-2), [Frost Vial (Moderate)](/item/frost-vial-moderate-player-core-2), [Frost Vial (Greater)](/item/frost-vial-greater-player-core-2), [Frost Vial (Major)](/item/frost-vial-major-player-core-2)

You take a status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Effect: Furious Finish
descr:
Granted by [Furious Finish](/feat/furious-finish-player-core-2)

You gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of rounds remaining in your Rage.

name: Effect: Giant's Lunge
descr:
Granted by [Giant'S Lunge](/feat/giant-s-lunge-player-core-2)

All your melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain reach 10.

name: Effect: Giant's Stature
descr:
Granted by [Giant'S Stature](/feat/giant-s-stature-player-core-2)

You become Large, increasing your reach by 5 feet and gaining the [Clumsy 1](/condition/clumsy-player-core) condition until you stop raging

name: Effect: Gladiator Dedication
descr:
Granted by [Gladiator Dedication](/feat/gladiator-dedication-player-core-2)

You gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

name: Effect: Goading Feint
descr:
Granted by [Goading Feint](/feat/goading-feint-player-core-2)

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against the opponent.

name: Effect: Grasping Snare
descr:
Granted by [Grasping Snare](/item/grasping-snare-player-core-2)

You take a –5-foot status penalty to your Speed.

name: Effect: Great Tengu Form
descr:
Granted by [Great Tengu Form](/feat/great-tengu-form-player-core-2)

You also gain the benefits of 4th-rank [Enlarge](/spell/enlarge-player-core) and [Fly](/spell/fly-player-core) spells.

name: Effect: Hag Blood Magic
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Hag](/feat/bloodline-hag-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank.

name: Effect: Hobbling Snare
descr:
Granted by [Hobbling Snare](/item/hobbling-snare-player-core-2)

You take a status penalty to your Speed.

name: Effect: Holy Chain
descr:
Granted by [Holy Chain](/item/holy-chain-player-core-2)

You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet. The wings shed bright light in a 40-foot radius (and dim light to the next 40 feet).

name: Effect: Hone Claws
descr:
Granted by [Hone Claws](/feat/hone-claws-player-core-2)

Your claws deal an additional 1d6 bleed damage.

name: Effect: Imperial Blood Magic
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Imperial](/feat/bloodline-imperial-player-core-2)

You gain your choice of either a +1 status bonus to AC or a +1 status bonus to saving throws.

name: Effect: Inescapable Grasp
descr:
Granted by [Inescapable Grasp](/feat/inescapable-grasp-player-core-2)

If you attempt to use a teleportation spell or effect while grabbed, you must succeed at a DC 15 flat check or the spell fails.

name: Effect: Inspiring Marshal Stance
descr:
Granted by [Inspiring Marshal Stance](/feat/inspiring-marshal-stance-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.

name: Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Juggernaut Mutagen (Greater)](/item/juggernaut-mutagen-greater-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +3 item bonus to Fortitude saves and 30 temporary Hit Points. When you roll a success on a Fortitude save, you get a critical success instead.

**Drawback** You take a -2 penalty to Will saves, Perception checks and initiative rolls.

name: Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Juggernaut Mutagen (Lesser)](/item/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +1 item bonus to Fortitude saves and 5 temporary Hit Points.

**Drawback** You take a -2 penalty to Will saves, Perception checks and initiative rolls.

name: Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Major)
descr:
Granted by [Juggernaut Mutagen (Major)](/item/juggernaut-mutagen-major-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +4 item bonus to Fortitude saves and 45 temporary Hit Points. When you roll a success on a Fortitude save you get a critical success instead, and your critical failures on Fortitude saves become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a -2 penalty to Will saves, Perception checks and initiative rolls.

name: Effect: Known Weaknesses
descr:
Granted by [Known Weaknesses](/feat/known-weaknesses-player-core-2).

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against the marked creature.

name: Effect: Leech-Clip
descr:
Granted by [Leech Clip](/feat/leech-clip-player-core-2)

You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speed (or a –15-foot status penalty on a critical hit).

name: Effect: Left-Hand Blood
descr:
Granted by [Left Hand Blood](/feat/left-hand-blood-player-core-2)

If you hit with the weapon and deal damage, the target also takes 1d4 persistent poison damage.

name: Effect: Marshal's Aura
descr:
Granted by [Marshal Dedication](/feat/marshal-dedication-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against fear.

name: Effect: Meddling Futures
descr:
Granted by [Meddling Futures](/feat/meddling-futures-player-core-2)

Roll 1d4 to see what type of spirit is drawn to you. You gain the listed benefit for the action. If you attempt to use a different action, you must succeed at a Flat DC 6 or the action is lost.

---

**1 Warrior** You must attempt a Strike. You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack roll and a +2 status bonus to damage, or a +6 status bonus to damage if you are at least cursebound 3.

**2 Adept** You must attempt a Perception check or a skill action. You gain a +1 status bonus to the check, or a +2 status bonus if you are cursebound 3.

**3 Sage** You must attempt to Cast a Spell. You gain a status bonus to the spell's damage or healing equal to the spell's rank, or equal to the spell's rank + 3 if you are at least cursebound 3.

**4 Wanderer** You must attempt a [Stride](/action/stride-player-core) action, or a Fly, Climb, or [Burrow](/action/burrow-player-core) action if you have the relevant speed. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed for the action, or a +20-foot status bonus if you are at least cursebound 3.

name: Effect: Moisture Bath
descr:
Granted by [Moisture Bath](/feat/moisture-bath-player-core-2)

You gain fire and cold resistance equal to half your level.

name: Effect: Mountain Stronghold
descr: You focus on your connection to the earth and call upon the mountain to block attacks against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Effect: Mudrock Snare
descr:
Granted by [Mudrock Snare](/item/mudrock-snare-player-core-2)

**Success** You take a –5-foot circumstance penalty to your Speed.

**Failure** You take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to your Speed.

**Critical Failure** You are are immobilized.

name: Effect: Mutagenist Field Benefit
descr:
Granted by [Mutagenist](/feat/mutagenist-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Intelligence modifier plus half your level.

name: Effect: Oracular Warning
descr:
Granted by [Oracular Warning](/feat/oracular-warning-player-core-2)

Each ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

name: Effect: Oracular Warning (Initiative)
descr:
Granted by [Oracular Warning](/feat/oracular-warning-player-core-2)

Each ally gains a +2 status bonus to their initiative roll. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Oracular Warning, the bonus increases to +3, and if you are cursebound 3, the bonus increases to +4.

name: Effect: Oversized Throw
descr:
Granted by [Oversized Throw](/feat/oversized-throw-player-core-2)

You gain a ranged Strike. It is a simple ranged weapon that deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage, has a range increment of 20 feet, and has the thrown weapon trait. The damage increases to 2d10 bludgeoning damage if you have weapon specialization in simple weapons, or 3d10 bludgeoning if you have greater weapon specialization.

name: Effect: Panache
descr:
Granted by [Panache](/feat/panache-player-core-2)

You gain panache.

name: Effect: Panache (Ephemeral Note)
descr:
Granted by [Flashy Dodge](/feat/flashy-dodge-player-core-2), [Extravagant Parry](/feat/extravagant-parry-player-core-2) via Ephemeral Effect.

If your Strike misses, the origin gains panache.

name: Effect: Panache (Temporary)
descr:
Granted by [Flashy Dodge](/feat/flashy-dodge-player-core-2), [Extravagant Parry](/feat/extravagant-parry-player-core-2), [Elegant Buckler](/feat/elegant-buckler-player-core-2), [Charmed Life](/feat/charmed-life-player-core-2), [Guardian's Deflection](/feat/guardian-s-deflection-swashbuckler-player-core-2), and bravado actions on a failure.

You gain panache.

name: Effect: Pinpoint Poisoner
descr:
Granted by [Pinpoint Poisoner](/feat/pinpoint-poisoner-player-core-2)

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your initial save against the poison.

name: Effect: Play to the Crowd (AC Bonus)
descr:
Granted by [Play To The Crowd](/feat/play-to-the-crowd-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Play to the Crowd (Attack Roll Bonus)
descr:
Granted by [Play To The Crowd](/feat/play-to-the-crowd-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll.

name: Effect: Play to the Crowd (Temporary Hit Points)
descr:
Granted by [Play To The Crowd](/feat/play-to-the-crowd-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your character level.

name: Effect: Pointed Question
descr:
Granted by [Pointed Question](/action/pointed-question-player-core-2)

You gain a circumstance bonus to your Perception DC if the marked creature attempts to Lie to you, and the marked creature is off-guard to the Strike you make against it using Devise a Stratagem.

name: Effect: Portentous Spell
descr:
Granted by [Portentous Spell](/feat/portentous-spell-player-core-2).

Any creature that attempts to use a reaction triggered by your Cast a Spell activity takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and skill checks rolled as part of the reaction.

name: Effect: Precious Ammunition
descr:
Granted by [Precious Ammunition](/feat/precious-ammunition-player-core-2)

Choose cold iron or silver; if you shoot the arrow or bolt before the end of your turn, it counts as that material. At 14th level, add adamantine to the list of materials you can choose from.

name: Effect: Prevailing Position
descr:
Granted by [Prevailing Position](/feat/prevailing-position-player-core-2)

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw or to your AC against the triggering attack.

name: Effect: Pride in Arms
descr:
Granted by [Pride In Arms](/feat/pride-in-arms-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier.

name: Effect: Quicksilver Mutagen (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Quicksilver Mutagen (Greater)](/item/quicksilver-mutagen-greater-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, Stealth checks, Thievery checks, Reflex saves, and Dexterity-based attack rolls, and you gain a +15 foot status bonus to your Speed.

**Drawback** You take damage equal to twice your level; you can't recover Hit Points lost this way by any means while the mutagen lasts. You take a -2 penalty to Fortitude saves.

name: Effect: Quicksilver Mutagen (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Quicksilver Mutagen (Lesser)](/item/quicksilver-mutagen-lesser-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, Stealth checks, Thievery checks, Reflex saves, and Dexterity-based attack rolls, and you gain a +5 foot status bonus to your Speed.

**Drawback** You take damage equal to twice your level; you can't recover Hit Points lost this way by any means while the mutagen lasts. You take a -2 penalty to Fortitude saves.

name: Effect: Quicksilver Mutagen (Major)
descr:
Granted by [Quicksilver Mutagen (Major)](/item/quicksilver-mutagen-major-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +4 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, Stealth checks, Thievery checks, Reflex saves, and Dexterity-based attack rolls, and you gain a +20 foot status bonus to your Speed.

**Drawback** You take damage equal to twice your level; you can't recover Hit Points lost this way by any means while the mutagen lasts. You take a -2 penalty to Fortitude saves.

name: Effect: Quicksilver Mutagen (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Quicksilver Mutagen (Moderate)](/item/quicksilver-mutagen-moderate-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, Stealth checks, Thievery checks, Reflex saves, and Dexterity-based attack rolls, and you gain a +10 foot status bonus to your Speed.

**Drawback** You take damage equal to twice your level; you can't recover Hit Points lost this way by any means while the mutagen lasts. You take a -2 penalty to Fortitude saves.

name: Effect: Rage
descr:
Granted by [Rage](/action/rage-player-core-2)

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier.

You deal additional damage on melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.

When you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and can't gain temporary Hit Points from using the Rage action again for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Rage Temporary Hit Points Immunity
descr:
Granted by [Rage](/action/rage-player-core-2)

You can't gain temporary Hit Points from using the Rage action.

name: Effect: Rallying Charge (Marshal)
descr:
Granted by [Rallying Charge (Marshal)](/feat/rallying-charge-marshal-player-core-2)

You gain temporary hit points equal to the Charisma modifier of the creature that used Rallying Charge.

name: Effect: Rejuvenating Touch
descr:
Granted by [Rejuvenating Touch](/feat/rejuvenating-touch-player-core-2)

You gain 10 temporary Hit Points immediately and at the start of your turns.

name: Effect: Renewed Vigor
descr:
Granted by [Renewed Vigor](/feat/renewed-vigor-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level plus your Constitution modifier. If you made an attack action this turn, increase the number of temporary Hit Points to your level plus your Constitution modifier.

name: Effect: Revitalizing Finisher
descr:
Granted by [Revitalizing Finisher](/feat/revitalizing-finisher-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Roll the Bones of Fate (Good)
descr:
Granted by [Roll The Bones Of Fate](/feat/roll-the-bones-of-fate-player-core-2)

You can roll twice on your next attack roll or skill check, taking the higher result.

name: Effect: Root Magic
descr:
Granted by [Root Magic](/feat/root-magic-player-core-2)

You gain a circumstance bonus to a saving throw against a spell or haunt.

name: Effect: Scout (Incredible Scout)
descr:
Granted by [Incredible Scout](/feat/incredible-scout-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll.

name: Effect: Serene Mutagen (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Serene Mutagen (Greater)](/item/serene-mutagen-greater-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +3 bonus to Will saves and Perception, Medicine, Nature, Religion, and Survival checks. This bonus improves to +4 when you attempt Will saves against mental effects. When you roll a success on a Will save against a mental effect, you get a critical success instead.

**Drawback** You take a -1 penalty to attack rolls and save DCs of offensive spells, and a -1 penalty per damage die to all weapon and unarmed attack damage.

name: Effect: Serene Mutagen (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Serene Mutagen (Lesser)](/item/serene-mutagen-lesser-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +1 bonus to Will saves and Perception, Medicine, Nature, Religion, and Survival checks. This bonus improves to +2 when you attempt Will saves against mental effects.

**Drawback** You take a -1 penalty to attack rolls and save DCs of offensive spells, and a -1 penalty per damage die to all weapon and unarmed attack damage.

name: Effect: Serene Mutagen (Major)
descr:
Granted by [Serene Mutagen (Major)](/item/serene-mutagen-major-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +4 bonus to Will saves and Perception, Medicine, Nature, Religion, and Survival checks. When you roll a success on a Will save against a mental effect, you get a critical success instead, and your critical failures on Will saves against mental effects become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a -1 penalty to attack rolls and save DCs of offensive spells, and a -1 penalty per damage die to all weapon and unarmed attack damage.

name: Effect: Serene Mutagen (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Serene Mutagen (Moderate)](/item/serene-mutagen-moderate-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 bonus to Will saves and Perception, Medicine, Nature, Religion, and Survival checks. This bonus improves to +3 when you attempt Will saves against mental effects.

You take a -1 penalty to attack rolls and save DCs of offensive spells, and a -1 penalty per damage die to all weapon and unarmed attack damage.

name: Effect: Share Rage
descr:
Granted by [Share Rage](/feat/share-rage-player-core-2)

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. While you are raging, you deal 2 additional damage on melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.

name: Effect: Shed Tail
descr:
Granted by [Shed Tail](/feat/shed-tail-player-core-2)

You take a -2 circumstance penalty on checks to Balance.

name: Effect: Shielding Salve
descr:
Granted by [Shielding Salve](/item/shielding-salve-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Silvertongue Mutagen (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Silvertongue Mutagen (Greater)](/item/silvertongue-mutagen-greater-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +3 item bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation and Performance checks. Your critical failures with any of these skills become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a -2 item penalty to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks. Choose one skill in which you are trained; for the duration, you become untrained in that skill. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

name: Effect: Silvertongue Mutagen (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Silvertongue Mutagen (Lesser)](/item/silvertongue-mutagen-lesser-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +1 item bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation and Performance checks. Your critical failures with any of these skills become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a -2 item penalty to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks. Choose one skill in which you are trained; for the duration, you become untrained in that skill. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

name: Effect: Silvertongue Mutagen (Major)
descr:
Granted by [Silvertongue Mutagen (Major)](/item/silvertongue-mutagen-major-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +4 item bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation and Performance checks. Your critical failures with any of these skills become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a -2 item penalty to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks. Choose one skill in which you are trained; for the duration, you become untrained in that skill. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

name: Effect: Silvertongue Mutagen (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Silvertongue Mutagen (Moderate)](/item/silvertongue-mutagen-moderate-player-core-2)

**Benefit** You gain a +2 item bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation and Performance checks. Your critical failures with any of these skills become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a -2 item penalty to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks. Choose one skill in which you are trained; for the duration, you become untrained in that skill. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

name: Effect: Sip of Justice
descr:
Granted by [Chalice Of Justice](/item/chalice-of-justice-player-core-2)

Whenever you critically hit an unholy creature with the *chalice of justice*, the creature takes 2d6 persistent spirit damage, and it's slowed 1 for 1 round. The persistent spirit damage has the [holy](/trait/holy) trait.

name: Effect: Skinstitch Salve
descr:
Granted by [Skinstitch Salve](/item/skinstitch-salve-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 item bonus to medicine checks and if you roll a success on Treat Wounds or Battle Medicine you get a critical success instead

name: Effect: Smite
descr:
Granted by [Smite](/feat/smite-player-core-2).

Designate one enemy you can see. Until the start of your next turn, your Strikes against that enemy gain a +3 status bonus to damage, increasing to +4 if you have master proficiency with the weapon or unarmed attack you're using for the Strike. If you're holy or unholy and the target has the opposite trait, the bonus is +4 (or +6 if you're a master).

name: Effect: Snap Out of It! (Marshal)
descr:
Granted by [Snap Out Of It! (Marshal)](/feat/snap-out-of-it-marshal-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Will save.

name: Effect: Soaring Flight
descr:
Granted by [Soaring Flight](/feat/soaring-flight-player-core-2)

You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement.

name: Effect: Soothing Vials
descr:
Granted by [Soothing Vials](/feat/soothing-vials-player-core-2)

The creature gains a +1 item bonus to the new Will saving throw.

name: Effect: Spirits' Interference
descr:
Granted by [Spirits' Interference](/feat/spirits-interference-player-core-2) via Ephemeral Effect.

You must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or your attack against the origin misses with no effect.

name: Effect: Steel Yourself!
descr:
Granted by [Steel Yourself!](/feat/steel-yourself-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points and a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves.

name: Effect: Strangle
descr:
Granted by [Strangle](/feat/strangle-player-core-2)

You must succeed at a DC 10 flat check or lose any action that requires speech. For an action requiring speech that is also a manipulate action, like Casting a Spell with the concentrate and [manipulate](/trait/manipulate) trait, you just roll a single DC 10 flat check, rather than an additional DC 5 flat check for being grabbed.

name: Effect: Surgical Shock (Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Surgical Shock](/feat/surgical-shock-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the next attack action you attempt against the target.

name: Effect: Sword Practice
descr:
Granted by [Tengu Weapon Familiarity](/feat/tengu-weapon-familiarity-player-core-2)

During your daily preparations, you can practice with a weapon from the sword group that's in your possession. You gain familiarity with that weapon as well. This lasts until you practice with a different sword in the same way.

name: Effect: Tail Toxin
descr:
Granted by [Tail Toxin](/action/tail-toxin-player-core-2)

You apply your tail's venom to a piercing or slashing weapon. If your next Strike with that weapon before the end of your next turn hits and deals damage, you deal persistent poison damage equal to your level to the target.

name: Effect: Taper of Sanctification
descr:
Granted by [Taper Of Sanctification](/item/taper-of-sanctification-player-core-2)

Your Strikes gain the holy or [unholy](/trait/unholy) trait (as appropriate for the candle).

name: Effect: Targeting Finisher
descr:
Granted by [Targeting Finisher](/feat/targeting-finisher-player-core-2)

You gain an effect based on the selected body part.

**Arm (or another limb used for attacks, such as a tentacle)** You are enfeebled 2.**Head** You are stupefied 2.**Legs** You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Effect: Targeting Finisher (Critical)
descr:
Granted by [Targeting Finisher](/feat/targeting-finisher-player-core-2)

You gain an effect based on the selected body part.

**Arm (or another limb used for attacks, such as a tentacle)** You are enfeebled 1.**Head** You are stupefied 1.**Legs** You take a –5-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Effect: The Bigger They Are
descr:
Granted by [The Bigger They Are](/feat/the-bigger-they-are-player-core-2)

You gain weakness to the origin's precision damage.

name: Effect: Tricky Liniment
descr:
Granted by [Tricky Liniment](/item/tricky-liniment-player-core-2)

You are granted a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks to Escape or to Squeeze.

name: Effect: Twist the Skeins of Fate
descr:
Granted by [Prognostic Veil](/item/prognostic-veil-player-core-2)

You gain a status bonus to the saving throw or attack roll equal to the value of the user's [Cursebound](/condition/cursebound-player-core-2) condition.

name: Effect: Uncanny Bombs
descr:
Granted by [Uncanny Bombs](/feat/uncanny-bombs-player-core-2)

You reduce any circumstance bonus to the target's AC from cover by 1.

name: Effect: Undead Blood Magic
descr:
Granted by [Bloodline: Undead](/feat/bloodline-undead-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank for 1 round.

name: Effect: Upstage
descr:
Granted by [Upstage](/action/upstage-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Vivacious Bravado
descr:
Granted by [Vivacious Bravado](/feat/vivacious-bravado-player-core-2).

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Charisma modifier.

name: Effect: Whispers of Weakness
descr:
Granted by [Whispers Of Weakness](/feat/whispers-of-weakness-player-core-2)

You target one creature. You gain a +2 status bonus to your next attack roll (or skill check made as part of an attack action) against that foe.

name: Spell Effect: Ancestral Form
descr:
Granted by [Ancestral Form](/spell/ancestral-form-player-core-2)

You gain resistance to all damage (except force and damage from Strikes with the ghost touch property rune), and this resistance is doubled against non-magical and precision damage.

You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Ancestral Memories
descr:
Granted by [Ancestral Memories](/spell/ancestral-memories-player-core-2)

You either gain a status bonus to the next spell attack roll you attempt, or an enemy takes a status penalty to the next saving throw they attempt against a spell you cast.

name: Spell Effect: Angelic Halo
descr:
Granted by Aura: Angelic Halo

If you are healed by a *[heal](/spell/heal-player-core)* spell, you gain a status bonus to Hit Points regained equal to double the *heal* spell's rank.

name: Spell Effect: Angelic Wings
descr:
Granted by [Angelic Wings](/spell/angelic-wings-player-core-2)

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings cast bright light in a 30-foot radius.

name: Spell Effect: Anointed Ground
descr:
Granted by [Anointed Ground](/spell/anointed-ground-player-core-2)

Choose aberrations, celestials, dragons, fiends, monitors, or undead. You gain a +1 status bonus to AC, attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws against the chosen creatures.

name: Spell Effect: Arcane Countermeasure
descr:
Granted by [Arcane Countermeasure](/spell/arcane-countermeasure-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 status bonus to any saving throws, skill checks, AC, or DC against the triggering spell.

name: Spell Effect: Armor of Bones
descr:
Granted by [Armor Of Bones](/spell/armor-of-bones-player-core-2)

You gain resistance to cold, electricity, fire, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Spell Effect: Battlefield Persistence
descr:
Granted by [Battlefield Persistence](/spell/battlefield-persistence-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering save.

name: Spell Effect: Bestial Curse (Critical Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Bestial Curse](/spell/bestial-curse-player-core-2)

The creature gains weakness 1 to silver.

name: Spell Effect: Bestial Curse (Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Bestial Curse](/spell/bestial-curse-player-core-2)

The creature gains weakness 1 to silver.

name: Spell Effect: Bullhorn
descr:
Granted by [Bullhorn](/spell/bullhorn-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to checks to [Coerce](/action/coerce-player-core) and auditory Performance checks to Perform at a large venue.

name: Spell Effect: Celestial Brand
descr:
Granted by [Celestial Brand](/spell/celestial-brand-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls and skill checks against the marked creature, and deal additional spirit damage to it.

name: Spell Effect: Countless Eyes
descr:
Granted by [Countless Eyes](/spell/countless-eyes-player-core-2)

You can't be flanked. When you roll a success on [Seek](/action/seek-player-core) action, you critically succeed instead.

name: Spell Effect: Diabolic Edict
descr:
Granted by [Diabolic Edict](/spell/diabolic-edict-player-core-2)

The target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks related to performing a particular task. If it refuses to perform the task you proclaimed, it instead takes a -1 status penalty to all its attack rolls and skill checks.

name: Spell Effect: Dragon Wings
descr:
Granted by [Dragon Wings](/spell/dragon-wings-player-core-2)

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 60 feet, whichever is greater.

name: Spell Effect: Elemental Motion
descr:
Granted by [Elemental Motion](/spell/elemental-motion-player-core-2)

You call upon your element to propel you, improving your Speed depending on your element.

**Air** You gain a fly Speed.**Earth** You gain a burrow Speed.**Fire** You gain a fly Speed.**Metal** You gain a burrow Speed.**Water** You gain a swim Speed.**Wood** You gain a climb Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Embrace Nothingness
descr:
Granted by [Embrace Nothingness](/spell/embrace-nothingness-player-core-2)

You gain resistance to physical damage equal to your level.

name: Spell Effect: Embrace the Pit
descr:
Granted by [Embrace The Pit](/spell/embrace-the-pit-player-core-2)

You gain resistance to fire, poison and physical damage (except silver).

name: Spell Effect: Faerie Dust (Critical Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Faerie Dust](/spell/faerie-dust-player-core-2)

The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.

name: Spell Effect: Faerie Dust (Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Faerie Dust](/spell/faerie-dust-player-core-2)

The creature takes a -2 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.

name: Spell Effect: Fey Disappearance
descr:
Granted by [Fey Disappearance](/spell/fey-disappearance-player-core-2)

You become invisible and ignore natural difficult terrain (such as underbrush).

name: Spell Effect: Flaming Fusillade
descr:
Granted by [Flaming Fusillade](/spell/flaming-fusillade-player-core-2)

When heightened to 9th rank, you gain a status bonus to damage dealt by *ignition* equal to *flaming fusillade*'s spell rank.

name: Spell Effect: Fortifying Brew
descr:
Granted by Fortifying Brew

You gain temporary Hit Points. On a critical success, you also gain a +2 status bonus to saves against diseases and poisons.

name: Spell Effect: Fungal Infestation
descr:
Granted by [Fungal Infestation](/spell/fungal-infestation-player-core-2)

You gain weakness to fire and weakness to slashing.

name: Spell Effect: Glutton's Jaws
descr:
Granted by [Glutton'S Jaws](/spell/glutton-s-jaws-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points.

name: Spell Effect: Incendiary Aura
descr:
Granted by [Incendiary Aura](/spell/incendiary-aura-player-core-2)

Each time a creature within the emanation takes fire damage, it catches on fire, taking 1d4 persistent fire damage.

name: Spell Effect: Inner Upheaval
descr:
Granted by [Inner Upheaval](/spell/inner-upheaval-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls with the Strikes, and the Strikes deal 1d6 extra damage of the chosen type.

---

**Heightened (+4)** The extra damage increases by 1d6.

name: Spell Effect: Lay on Hands
descr:
Granted by [Lay On Hands](/spell/lay-on-hands-player-core-2)

You gain a +2 status bonus to AC. If you're undead, you take a –2 status penalty to AC instead.

name: Spell Effect: Leaden Steps
descr:
Granted by [Leaden Steps](/spell/leaden-steps-player-core-2)

The target is [Encumbered](/condition/encumbered-player-core) and has a weakness to electricity.

name: Spell Effect: Life-Giving Form
descr:
Granted by [Life Giving Form](/spell/life-giving-form-player-core-2)

Your body exudes bright light like a torch. You gain resistance to precision damage and weakness to void damage, and your unarmed Strikes deal extra vitality damage.

name: Spell Effect: Primal Herd
descr:
Granted by Primal Herd

You transform into a mammoth, and you assume a Huge battle form. You gain the [animal](/trait/animal) trait. You gain the following while transformed.

AC = 22 + your level. Ignore any armor check penalty and Speed reduction.

20 temporary Hit Points.

Speed 40 feet.

Low-light vision.

The following unarmed melee attacks, which are the only attacks you can use to Strike. When Striking with these attacks, you use your attack modifier with the proficiency and item bonuses of your most favorable weapon or unarmed Strike, and the damage is listed for each attack. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) condition, for example).

**Melee** 1 tusk (reach 15 feet), **Damage** 4d8+19 piercing**Melee** 1 trunk (agile, reach 15 feet), **Damage** 4d6+16 bludgeoning**Melee** 1 foot (agile, reach 15 feet), **Damage** 4d6+13 bludgeoning.

Athletics modifier of +30, unless your own modifier is higher.

You can use the [Trample](/action/trample-monster-core) action.

**Trample** 3 You move up to twice your Speed and move through the space of Large or smaller creatures, trampling each creature whose space you enter. A trampled creature takes damage from your foot Strike based on a basic Reflex DC 19 save.

name: Spell Effect: Qi Form
descr:
Granted by [Qi Form](/spell/qi-form-player-core-2)

You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. Choose force, spirit, vitality, or void damage. All your Strikes deal 1d6 additional damage of the chosen type.

Your entire body is also surrounded by a glowing corona of the same color as your inner qi; this is a light effect. Your corona is an aura in a 5-foot emanation that deals 2d6 untyped damage of the chosen type to creatures who start their turn within the emanation. You can Sustain to flare your corona out to become a 30-foot emanation or return the corona to a 5-foot emanation.

Your weapons and unarmed attacks lose the [nonlethal](/trait/nonlethal) trait. You take a -2 status penalty to saves against emotion effects but gain a +2 status bonus to saves against all other mental effects.

name: Spell Effect: Revel in Retribution
descr:
Granted by [Revel In Retribution](/spell/revel-in-retribution-player-core-2)

You gain the [Reactive Strike](/action/reactive-strike-player-core) ability. Whenever you successfully hit with a Reactive Strike, you gain temporary Hit Points.

name: Spell Effect: Revel in Retribution (Temp HP)
descr:
Granted by [Revel In Retribution](/spell/revel-in-retribution-player-core-2)

You gain temporary Hit Points.

name: Spell Effect: Sacred Form
descr:
Granted by [Sacred Form](/spell/sacred-form-player-core-2)

You gain the following statistics and abilities.

AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

10 temporary Hit Points.

Speed 40 feet.

Resistance 3 against physical damage.

Darkvision.

A special attack with a sacred armament, which is the only attack you can use. Your attack modifier with the sacred armament is +21, and your damage bonus is +8. The damage dice for Strikes with the weapon are 3d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 spirit damage.

Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own is higher.

---

**Heightened (8th)** You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary Hit Points, resistance 4 against physical damage, attack modifier +28, damage bonus +15, and Athletics +29. If you're Medium or smaller, your battle form is Large, and your attacks also have 10-foot reach.

name: Spell Effect: Schadenfreude (Success)
descr:
Granted by [Schadenfreude](/spell/schadenfreude-player-core-2)

You take a -1 status penalty on Perception checks and Will saves.

name: Spell Effect: Scintillating Safeguard
descr:
Granted by [Scintillating Safeguard](/spell/scintillating-safeguard-player-core-2)

You gain resistance to a physical or energy damage type.

name: Spell Effect: Seal Fate
descr:
Granted by [Seal Fate](/spell/seal-fate-player-core-2)

You gain weakness to the chosen damage type.

name: Spell Effect: Shields of the Spirit
descr:
Granted by [Shields Of The Spirit](/spell/shields-of-the-spirit-player-core-2)

**Champion:** You Raise your Shield.

**Ally:** You gain a +1 status bonus to AC while in the Champion's aura.

name: Spell Effect: Shields of the Spirit (Security)
descr:
Granted by [Security](/feat/security-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC.

---

Granted by [Greater Security](/feat/greater-security-player-core-2)

If the champion's shield is raised, you gain the same bonus to AC their shield grants.

name: Spell Effect: Spectral Advance
descr:
Granted by [Spectral Advance](/spell/spectral-advance-player-core-2)

You have resistance equal to your level to all damage.

name: Spell Effect: Spirit Sense
descr:
Granted by [Spirit Sense](/spell/spirit-sense-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 status bonus to the following checks regarding haunts or spirits: Perception checks to [Seek](/action/seek-player-core), attempts to [Recall Knowledge](/action/recall-knowledge-player-core), skill checks to determine the reason for their existence, and skill checks to disable a haunt. You also gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws against haunts and spirits.

name: Spell Effect: Synesthesia (Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Synesthesia](/spell/synesthesia-player-core-2)

You must succeed at a DC 5 flat check each time you use a concentrate action, or the action fails and is wasted. You are clumsy 3 and have a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds. On a critical failure, you are also stunned 2.

name: Spell Effect: Synesthesia (Success)
descr:
Granted by [Synesthesia](/spell/synesthesia-player-core-2)

You must succeed at a DC 5 flat check each time you use a concentrate action, or the action fails and is wasted. You are clumsy 3 and have a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Spell Effect: Tempest Touch
descr:
Granted by [Tempest Touch](/spell/tempest-touch-player-core-2)

You take a circumstance penalty to your Speeds.

name: Spell Effect: Touch of the Void
descr:
Granted by [Touch of Corruption](/spell/touch-of-the-void-player-core-2).

If the target is yourself, you gain a +2 status bonus to damage rolls. Otherwise, the target takes a –2 status penalty to AC.

name: Spell Effect: Unusual Anatomy
descr:
Granted by [Unusual Anatomy](/spell/unusual-anatomy-player-core-2)

You gain resistance to precision damage and resistance to extra damage from critical hits, and you gain darkvision.

name: Spell Effect: Weapon Trance
descr:
Granted by [Weapon Trance](/spell/weapon-trance-player-core-2)

Your proficiency with martial weapons is equal to your proficiency with simple weapons.

name: Spell Effect: Wind Jump
descr:
Granted by [Wind Jump](/spell/wind-jump-player-core-2)

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Stance: Buckler Dance
descr:
Granted by [Buckler Dance](/feat/buckler-dance-player-core-2)

You constantly have your buckler raised as if you'd used Raise a Shield.

name: Stance: Clinging Shadows Stance
descr:
Granted by [Clinging Shadows Stance](/spell/clinging-shadows-stance-player-core-2)

You can make shadow grasp Strikes. These deal 1d4 void damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, grapple, reach, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

While in the clinging shadows stance, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Grapple, and to the DC for creatures to Escape from you.

name: Stance: Cobra Stance
descr:
Granted by [Cobra Stance](/feat/cobra-stance-player-core-2)

The only Strikes you can make are cobra fang unarmed attacks. These deal 1d4 piercing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, deadly d10, finesse, unarmed, and [venomous](/trait/venomous) traits.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and your Fortitude DC, and you gain poison resistance equal to half your level.

name: Stance: Cobra Stance (Cobra Envenom)
descr:
Granted by [Cobra Stance](/feat/cobra-stance-player-core-2) if you have [Cobra Envenom](/feat/cobra-envenom-player-core-2), which increases the circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and Fortitude DC to +2.

The only Strikes you can make are cobra fang unarmed attacks. These deal 1d4 poison damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, deadly d10, finesse, nonlethal, poison, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and your Fortitude DC, and you gain poison resistance equal to half your level.

name: Stance: Crane Stance
descr:
Granted by [Crane Stance](/feat/crane-stance-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, but the only Strikes you can make are crane wing attacks. These deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

Reduce the DC for High Jump and Long Jump by 5, and when you Leap, you can move an additional 5 feet horizontally or 2 feet vertically.

name: Stance: Dragon Stance
descr:
Granted by [Dragon Stance](/feat/dragon-stance-player-core-2)

You can make dragon tail attacks that deal 1d10 bludgeoning damage. They are in the brawling group and have the backswing, nonlethal, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

You can ignore the first square of difficult terrain while Striding.

name: Stance: Dread Marshal Stance
descr:
Granted by [Dread Marshal Stance](/feat/dread-marshal-stance-player-core-2).

Your marshal's aura grants you and allies a status bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of weapon damage dice of the unarmed attack or weapon the you are wielding that has the most weapon damage dice. When you or an ally in the aura critically hits an enemy with a Strike, that enemy is [Frightened 1](/condition/frightened-player-core).

name: Stance: Inspiring Marshal Stance
descr:
Granted by [Inspiring Marshal Stance](/feat/inspiring-marshal-stance-player-core-2).

Your marshal's aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.

name: Stance: Ironblood Stance
descr:
Granted by [Ironblood Stance](/feat/ironblood-stance-player-core-2)

You can make iron sweep unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; and have the nonlethal, parry, sweep, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

While in Ironblood Stance, you gain resistance 2 to all damage. The resistance increases to 3 at 12th level, to 4 at 16th level, and to 5 at 20th level.

Effect: Parry

name: Stance: Monastic Archer Stance
descr:
Granted by [Monastic Archer Stance](/feat/monastic-archer-stance-player-core-2)

The only Strikes you can make are those using longbows, shortbows, or bows with the [monk](/trait/monk) trait.

You can use Flurry Of Blows with these bows. You can use your other monk feats or monk abilities that normally require unarmed attacks with these bows when attacking within half the first range increment (normally 50 feet for a longbow and 30 feet for a shortbow), so long as the feat or ability doesn't require a single, specific Strike.

name: Stance: Mountain Stance
descr:
Granted by [Mountain Stance](/feat/mountain-stance-player-core-2)

The only Strikes you can make are falling stone unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; and have the forceful, nonlethal, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

You gain a +4 item bonus to AC and a +2 circumstance bonus to any defenses against being Shoved or Tripped. However, you have a Dexterity modifier cap to your AC of +0, meaning you don't add your Dexterity to your AC, and your Speeds are all reduced by 5 feet. The item bonus to AC from Mountain Stance is cumulative with armor potency runes on your explorer's clothing, mage armor, and bracers of armor.

name: Stance: Shooting Stars Stance
descr:
Granted by [Shooting Stars Stance](/feat/shooting-stars-stance-player-core-2)

You can use your monk feats or monk abilities that normally require unarmed attacks with shuriken instead.

name: Stance: Stumbling Stance
descr:
Granted by [Stumbling Stance](/feat/stumbling-stance-player-core-2)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to [Feint](/action/feint-player-core).

The only Strikes you can make are stumbling swing unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, backstabber, finesse, nonlethal, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits. If an enemy hits you with a melee Strike while in this stance, it becomes off-guard against the next stumbling swing Strike you make against it before the end of your next turn.

name: Stance: Tangled Forest Stance
descr:
Granted by [Tangled Forest Stance](/feat/tangled-forest-stance-player-core-2)

You can make lashing branch unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

name: Stance: Tiger Stance
descr:
Granted by [Tiger Stance](/feat/tiger-stance-player-core-2)

You can make tiger claw attacks. These deal 1d8 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

On a critical success with your tiger claws, if you deal damage, the target takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

As long as your Speed is at least 20 feet while in Tiger Stance, you can Step 10 feet.

name: Stance: Whirling Blade Stance
descr:
Granted by [Whirling Blade Stance](/feat/whirling-blade-stance-player-core-2)

All melee monk weapons you wield with the [finesse](/trait/finesse) trait gain the thrown 10 feet trait (unless they already have the [thrown](/trait/thrown) trait with a greater range).

Once you've made a thrown Strike with such a weapon, you can use the precision of your throw to make additional strikes with it, even from a distance. Start from the space of the previous Strike's target to determine the range increment and whether the new target has cover. At the end of your turn, the thrown weapon flies directly back to you in a straight line. If a solid barrier blocks its path, it falls to the ground after hitting the barrier.

name: Stance: Wild Winds Stance
descr:
Granted by [Wild Winds Stance](/spell/wild-winds-stance-player-core-2)

You can make wind crash unarmed Strikes as ranged Strikes against targets within 30 feet. These deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage, use the brawling group, and have the agile, nonlethal, propulsive, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits. Wind crash Strikes ignore concealment and all cover.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks.

name: Stance: Wolf Stance
descr:
Granted by [Wolf Stance](/feat/wolf-stance-player-core-2)

You can make wolf jaw unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 piercing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, backstabber, finesse, nonlethal, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

If you're flanking a target while in Wolf Stance, your wolf jaw unarmed attacks also gain the [trip](/trait/trip) trait.
